definitions.short case: printed 3Q26 nights <= 8.5% (latent < 8.55) OR C02 = (d) OR C04 = (d); literal reading defended from the QUESTIONS.md X01 text in the log's convention 3 (A19-02)
definitions.base: DECELERATING print (latent < 10.09, S01 rev-2's dead-band line on 2Q26's 10.34%) AND (C02 in {b, c} OR C01 = Yes) AND not short case; revision 1's gate was 'print < 10.6%', which is the breaker threshold (A19-01)
definitions.none of the above: everything else: accelerating print with a non-(a) descriptor and no short gate 0.065; in-line print 10.09-10.59 with no short gate 0.059; decel print with C02 (a)/(e) and the guide at/above 0.011
definitions.precedence: thesis breaker > short case > base > none. NOT settled by the question text or any repo document (A19-07): a stated convention. Breaker-and-short overlap (C04 (d) on a breaker print) 0.0326 goes to the breaker; short-first is published beside it

material.definition: short-case C02 leg = an explicit mid-single-or-lower BUCKET only, not the directional 'moderate' sentence; the explicit-bucket share of C02 (d) is branch-varying, 0.492 (<9) / 0.348 (9-10) / 0.208 (>=10), derived from C02 rev 2's own conditioning block (A19-10), not a constant 0.387

short_first_precedence.note: use this split if the memo keeps its own breaker column, which requires an FY sentence at 'approximately 36%' (C04 (b)) and therefore does not own the overlap draw

final.note: pending-decision structure (every gate is a 5 Nov disclosure); the short case is the modal option on every reading, precedence and gate tested (0.44-0.59); no option below 0.13. Two of its three legs are language events with weak or no precedent (FY floor 0 of 16 softened, 3 of 3 Novembers raised; explicit mid-single bucket 1 of 17 descriptors): 0.55 is a wording bet and should be described as one.

print_partition_table.what_it_is: the 12-month scenario object, gated on the printed 3Q26 nights rate alone under the adopted N(9.5, 1.70). THIS is what the memo's 25/45/30 row is (A19-04); X01's vector above is the 5 Nov disclosure-gate object. The memo must label which table is which; neither replaces the other.
print_partition_table.note: the conditionals are monotone, which the disclosure-gate table's are not; this is the table a 12-month scenario column should carry. The memo's $115-130 short-case price is a 12-month fundamental target (FY27 31.9% margin, +4.5% growth) and must be labelled as such: nothing in this run produces it for 15 Dec.

memo_conjunctive_short_mass.note: both of the memo's scenario columns, read conjunctively as their column headers are written, are about 0.05. A judge shown 0.55 against a column headed '<=8.5%, guide implies <=7.5%, no bundle figure, floor at risk' will assume the memo believes P(that conjunction) = 0.55; it is 0.046.

scenario_table.columns: P; day-1 return from the S01 rev-2 cells (median %, mean %, P(<= -8%), P(>= +5%), P(<0)); 15 Dec close from the S02 rev-2 branches rescaled to S02's final median (conditional median and mean USD, p25-p75, P(<=150), P(>=180)); E[nights]; P(C01 below). CORRECTED to the decelerating base gate (A19-03).
scenario_table.read: Under the corrected gate base and short are NOT the same trade and the ordering reverses: base is worse on the day (-4.7% vs -3.8%) and at 15 Dec ($160.6 vs $161.9), P(<=-8%) 0.356 vs 0.327. The reason is compositional: a corrected base cell is 100% decelerating prints, while the option labelled 'short case' is not the bad-print option - 0.342 of its mass is a directional 'moderate' word with no number, 0.102 of its draws are in S01's accelerating state and 0.199 of them (0.110 of total probability) sit on a print >= 10.0% nights. The run's reaction function prices the print state and the guide-vs-Street sign, not the descriptor wording or the margin sentence, so the memo cannot put a lower 5 Nov price on the short-case row than on the base row. Supporting evidence is the two-window regression (W1 n 9 slope -1.24 corr -0.620; W2 n 6 slope -1.62 corr -0.586: within decelerating prints, deeper decelerations sold LESS hard), not revision 1's four-observation +1.8% mean, which is carried by 4Q22, outside both windows (A19-06).
scenario_table.none_cell_warning: 'none of the above' is not 'nothing happens': 0.48 of it is an accelerating print, 0.44 an in-line print (10.09-10.59), P(C01 below | none) = 0.54, day-1 median +0.3%.

pw_15dec.why: medians do not mix, so sum(P x conditional median) is not a probability-weighted close (A19-08); and the memo's own probability-weighted price (~$146) is built from scenario RANGE MIDPOINTS, a mean-type convention. If the memo prefers 164.8 it must be labelled pw_dec15_median_of_branches. One convention per document.

joint_option_x_print.note: the 10.0-10.6 row is where the gate correction lands: the dead band 10.09-10.59 (mass 0.1034) splits 0.428 short / 0.572 none under the corrected gate, against 0.497 base / 0.428 short / 0.075 none under revision 1's. Total probability reclassified base -> none: 0.0514.

c01_p_below.validation: C01's own monitoring[6] reads 0.78 at printed GBV $25.9bn and 0.55 at $26.6bn; the joint gives 0.795 given x < 10.0 and 0.567 given x >= 10.6 (E[x] 11.96 -> GBV ~ $26.5bn). This is why C01's 0.66%/1% of GBV slope is used and S01's 0.32 is the sensitivity (A19-15).

unconditional_day1.note: X01's day-1 is S01 REBASED onto the adopted print states; S01's published numbers are not. Revision 1 printed -2.4 for the median; the model's own output file says -2.50 (A19-16, extended). SYNTHESIS must name which object it carries and the memo must quote one.

dec15_percentiles.note: the 0.65/0.35 options blend applied as a location rescale is adequate across the whole distribution, not only at the median (A19-11 check). Unconditional mean 167.2 (revision 1 printed 167.3).

joint_structure.script: docs/pitch-forecasts/questions/scenario-probabilities/datasets/x01_joint.py (numpy + stdlib, seed 20260917, n 1,000,000) - UNCHANGED in revision 2; classification and tables in datasets/x01_reclassify_v2.py (writes x01_v2_summary.json)
joint_structure.print: latent 3Q26 nights y/y ~ N(9.5, 1.70) [adopted_print_states_v2.json, R01/R02 rev 2]
joint_structure.c01: gap ~ N(g0 + 0.66 (nights - 9.5), 3.1), g0 = -1.923 solved for P(gap < 0) = 0.72. The 0.66 is % of guide per 1% of 3Q26 GBV; per POINT of nights growth it is 0.60 (A19-15 unit correction)
joint_structure.c02: log-odds piecewise-linear in nights through C02 rev 2's three branch conditionals (anchored at 7.86 / 9.51 / 11.24), per-option factors IPF-fitted so the marginal under N(9.5, 1.70) equals C02's final vector; the (c or d) block split by C01 at odds ratio 2 (S01)
joint_structure.c04: C04 rev 2's published conditionals on C01 (below / not below); independent of the print given C01
joint_structure.day1: S01 rev 2 twelve-cell tables (state x C01 x C02 c/d), inverse-CDF sampling of the published percentile/threshold points
joint_structure.dec15: S02 rev 2 branch medians (172.3 / 165.5 / 163.0 / 156.1) x 1.0156, within-branch log-sd 0.171 = sqrt((0.30 x sqrt(62/252))^2 + 0.0845^2). 62 sessions = S02's 36 pre-print + 26 post-print, which is the right count for a branch-conditional spread (knowing the branch does not resolve pre-print diffusion); revision 1's PROSE said 26, the code always said 62 (A19-11)
joint_structure.correlations_assumed: C02 depends on the print (its own tree) and on C01 (OR 2); C04 depends on C01 only; the day-1 return depends on the S01 state and C01 and not on C02 wording or C04; no other links
joint_structure.dependence_not_modelled: given the branch, the day-1 return and the 15 Dec close are drawn from INDEPENDENT uniforms. Measured corr(day-1, log 15 Dec) = 0.063 unconditionally and 0.003 / -0.000 / -0.001 within the decel / flat / accel states: all of the dependence in this file is branch mixing. Per-option marginals are sound; no day-1 x 15 Dec joint statement ('if 5 Nov is -8%, where is 15 Dec') may be taken from this file (A19-12).

short_case_composition.note: revision 1 wrote '0.110 of the short case has a print >= 10.0%' and the audit repeated it as 'a tenth'; 0.110 is unconditional MASS, and conditional on the short case it is 0.199 - one draw in five.

estimates.independence_note: NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_DERIVED for the base-rate / decomposition pair: the W2 panel's short cell is driven by the (d) descriptor frequency (8 of 17), which is also ~30% of the weight inside C02's own final vector that the joint is IPF-fitted to reproduce exactly. estimates.rounding_note: raw joint 0.1394 / 0.1717 / 0.5547 / 0.1342; 'none' rounded up to 0.14 at the short case's expense rather than by largest remainder, because the W2 panel puts none at 0.30 under this gate and the resolution-criteria audit concedes another 0.02-0.03 would move to none under a broader reading of 'in-line print with in-line guide'.
